host_exceptions.runner_image: ubuntu-24.04 is a GitHub-managed mutable VM image; GitHub does not offer digest selection for hosted runner images. Record ImageOS/ImageVersion and installed packages.
host_exceptions.kernel_kvm_nbd: The hosted kernel and KVM/NBD modules are supplied by GitHub. Replacing/rebooting the hosted kernel is outside this job; record uname and module metadata.
host_exceptions.bootstrap_and_shared_libraries: Runner apt/dpkg/Python and already-installed shared libraries remain host inputs. Snapshot packages and newly resolved dependencies are fixed; this is not a hermetic runner. Record the full installed dpkg inventory.
